checks: manifest validates with zero schema issues
do not invent top-level fields; source baseline belongs in preflight.files
execution.timeout_seconds and post_patch command timeouts are integers 1..1800 when present
exactly one Python entrypoint OR PATCH_TOOL_OPS.json, never both
declare targets whenever mutable files are known
declare exact preflight.files path/exists/sha256/anchors for source assumptions
post_patch command executable/cwd must exist on target OS
rollback only with complete exact target baseline
run read-only validate before delivery when the project/source is available
normal execution must re-run preflight before payload
batch.depends_on uses existing manifest.patch.id values and all required dependencies are selected
after a FAIL_HANDOFF, any successor PATCH explicitly declares batch.previous_failure with patch_id/patch_file, action and reason unless retrying the failed PATCH itself
previous_failure.action is exactly delete, retry_before, run_after or block; never leave the failed predecessor orphaned
continue_independent is used only when independent continuation is safe; unsafe partial/rollback/tool failures must safety-stop
OPS idempotency uses explicit already markers; do not assume new text appearing elsewhere means the target operation was already applied
batch transaction mode declares complete manifest targets; tool expands effective targets from preflight/recovery/OPS metadata and rejects post_patch or Git add/commit/push side effects
every PATCH failure creates a FAIL_HANDOFF with automatic bounded related-source discovery and SOURCE_DISCOVERY.json; recovery.fail_handoff=false is ignored
